index: momentum theory with a figure of merit

rows.used for: induced drag of the two wings against one monoplane of the same span
rows.source: Prandtl, NACA TR 116 (1924); Munk's stagger theorem
rows.applicability: equal spans, zero stagger, gap/span 0.1–0.5 (here 0.28); the lattice checks it

rows._index: momentum theory with a figure of merit
rows.used for: hover power per rotor: P = T^{3/2} / sqrt(2 ρ A) / FM
rows.source: Glauert; FM from Boreas BEMT (generic blade section, prop_lab calibration when on file)
rows.applicability: uniform inflow, no interference between the four discs, no ground effect
rows.uncertainty: ±15 % on the hover power (the FM of a 9-inch propeller is 0.5–0.65)

rows.used for: Cd0 from wetted areas: turbulent flat-plate skin friction with form factors, cylinders in cross-flow, an interference allowance
rows.source: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag; Prandtl–Schlichting Cf; Cd 1.1 for a tube at Re ~5e3, 0.12 in a 3:1 fairing
rows.applicability: Re 5e4–5e5, attached flow; no gaps, no protuberances
rows.uncertainty: ±20 % on Cd0 (the campaign's bare sweep read 0.8 × the model's)

rows.used for: e = 0.90 × the lattice's inviscid span efficiency
rows.source: a rule of thumb for built-up small wings

rows.used for: the wing's forces beyond the stall, blended to a flat plate at 90°
rows.source: Viterna & Corrigan (1981), the flat-plate normal force with cd90 from the aspect ratio
rows.applicability: time-averaged post-stall loads of a straight wing; **not** a model of stall onset, hysteresis or unsteady transition aerodynamics
rows.uncertainty: ±30 % beyond 20°; the transition verdicts inherit it

rows.used for: cl_max (×0.9 for a built-up wing), α₀, the elevon's flap effectiveness τ, the section drag ratio
rows.source: NeuralFoil surrogate of XFOIL (Sharpe, 2024) at n_crit 6
rows.applicability: Re 5e4–1e6, smooth sections; the reflexed line's confidence 0.84–0.91, the 0012's 0.96
rows.uncertainty: ±0.1 on cl_max, ±15 % on cd; XFOIL or a slab CFD is the check

rows.used for: the propellers' destabilising normal-force slope in the neutral point
rows.source: De Young, J. Aircraft 2 (1965); prop_lab's cn_factor when on file
rows.applicability: advance ratio below ~1.5, small inflow angles
rows.uncertainty: ±30 %; it moves the static margin by ~0.01 chord

rows.used for: the slipstream velocity the blown spans see in the transition model
rows.source: momentum theory, uniform jet, fully developed at the wing
rows.applicability: a wing close behind the disk sees less than the fully developed Δv

rows.used for: spar stress and deflection, strut forces, buckling margins
rows.source: beam and truss statics; Euler columns pin-ended
rows.applicability: linear elastic, the joints ideal; the FEA case checks it
rows.uncertainty: the joint stiffness is not in it: ±25 % on the deflection

rows.used for: carbon tube 400 MPa (compression, knock-down 0.8), PETG 45 MPa in plane / 27 MPa across the layers (knock-down 0.7)
rows.source: supplier data and printed-coupon literature; no coupon test of these parts
rows.applicability: room temperature, dry; printed parts at 100 % infill

rows.used for: the lift slope, the span efficiency, the neutral point of the wing pair
rows.applicability: attached flow, small angles: it knows nothing of the stall
rows.uncertainty: ±5 % on the lift slope (the campaign's sweep read within 2 %)

verdict: Kestrel-4Q-2: 7 of 11 checks hold (screening pass: unvalidated — CFD and FEA labelled NOT RUN where missing).
Mass 1.65 kg, static margin 0.092 c, hover T/W 2.95 at 214 W; cruise 16 m/s at 59 W for 40 min (L/D 10.6); stall 9.6 m/s on the polar's CL max 1.03.

The CFD sweep (solver (unconverged: indicative)) reads CL max 0.53 below 20° against the polar's 1.03: if it holds, the stall is 13.4 m/s and the cruise only 1.20 × it — the fine stall campaign decides the wing area.
Transitions (reduced-order model): forward pass; back as is FAIL; with a remedy pass.
FEA: NOT RUN — the plane frame's spar reserve stands in.
Pursuit: V max 33.3 m/s (thrust-limited), corner radius 9.6 m, best climb 30.9 m/s.
